text: S710 fixes our source-side verification gap: the package verifier binds the original drawing hash but cannot compare a rewritten receiver DXF back to its unchanged manifest. Add a separate fail-closed return audit and test existing negative fixtures; use S708's saved Polo M return as evidence. No new app/format/mode, 73-option run, geometry change or gate relaxation. This advances identity/safety checks but does not qualify the industrial profile.
